'''Skaelor Tay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was part of a [[Lok slicers|group of slicers]] that was based in a [[Slicer House|building]] not far from [[Nym's Stronghold]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. The group also included [[Kelson Sharphorn]] and [[Byd Chillings]]. He was armed with a [[Striker projectile pistol|Striker pistol]].<ref name="SWG:KST" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he narrowly escaped potential injuries or death when the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump terrorists]] planted an [[Bomb/Legends|explosive device]] in the slicers' house. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had infiltrated the Meatlump gang found the bomb in time and defused it.<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Muddle the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Skaelor Tay was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KST" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Skaelor Tay and the Lok slicers were added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> Skaelor Tay and other slicer NPCs were not part of any quest but they were indirectly involved in the so-called "[[:w:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]". In the basement of the Slicer House, there was a bomb that the player had to defuse as part of the quest "[[:w:c:swg:Muddle the Meatlumps|Muddle the Meatlumps]]." While there were several slicer NPC enemies in the house, none of them had to be killed for the mission.<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> "[[:w:c:swg:Chronicle Relic|Chronicle Relics]]" could be looted from them. Such relics could be used by players in the [[:w:c:swg:Chronicle Quest|Chronicle Quest system]] to create their own quests for other players. By using the relics related to the slicer NPCs, the quests would task the player with killing Skaelor Tay or other slicers in the house.<ref name="SWG:relics">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chronicle Relics: "Kill Slicer Sentries", "Kill Slicer Students", "Kill Slicer Quality Assurance Staff Members", "Kill Skaelor Tay", "Kill Skaelor Tay", "Kill Skaelor Tay"</ref> Tay was a Level 58 [[:w:c:swg:Elite|Gold Elite]] NPC, which meant that he was considerably stronger and harder to kill than normal NPCs at this level.<ref name="SWG:KST" />
